channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Isaiah Stewart | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Isaiah Stewart from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: LeBron James on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
LeBron on seeing Isaiah Stewart charge at him:

“He’s chasing the sh*t out of me and I’m like get this big motherf**ker up off me. That’s a big boy.”

LeBron James on Isaiah Stewart, Jul 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Jalen Duren on playing alongside Isaiah Stewart:

“That’s my brother, man. He’s probably one of the best teammates I ever had. And it’s not even for like the probably the extra stuff y’all see and all that goes on. It’s just the simple fact that who he is as a man. Like man to man, he’s my guy dog. He’s that guy you can talk to. He’s a guy that’s always going to be there for you. He’s a guy that as a teammate you wouldn’t want nobody else. He’s a guy that you hate to play against but love to play with. I wouldn’t ask for nobody else to be on my squad.”

Jalen Duren on Isaiah Stewart, Apr 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Devin Booker on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Giannis to Booker:

“You make everything look cool, man, but you wear a different jersey than me, you could wear the same jersey as me, I’m like Isaiah Stewart, I’ll fight for you.”

Devin Booker on Isaiah Stewart, Feb 24, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Isaiah Stewart, Cade Cunningham, Jalen Duren
item.description:
said Thomas in a one-on-one interview with R.org.

“They have know how and what I mean by know how, they know how to win. Cade Cunningham is possibly MVP of the league. They got (Jalen) Duren, who’s an All Star. They got (Isaiah) Stewart, who could be the defensive player of the year also. They’re covered in every area they got. They got great coaching.”

Isiah Thomas on Isaiah Stewart, Cade Cunningham, Jalen Duren, Feb 17, 2026. Source: R.Org Sports.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Isaiah Stewart, Jaden Ivey
item.description:
Trajan on Jaden Ivey and Isaiah Stewart's injury status:

“I wouldn't say there a full go but they’re coming along. They’ll be ready for camp.”

Trajan Langdon on Isaiah Stewart, Jaden Ivey, Jun 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Monty Williams on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Williams on Stewart:

“He's one of the best in the league -- and people talk about guarding 1-5 -- not everyone is in that list. He's one of the best.”

Monty Williams on Isaiah Stewart, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Monty Williams on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Monty on the starting lineup with Stewart:

“We’re gonna run with these guys for a while and see if we get some synergy, especially on defense.”

Monty Williams on Isaiah Stewart, Feb 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Mike Muscala, Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Monty on Stewart and Muscala being out:

“It takes some physicality, some shooting away. It is what it is. I never think about it that way… the reality is they you look at what you have and make the most of that rotation.”

Monty Williams on Mike Muscala, Isaiah Stewart, Feb 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Monty on Stewart playing the 4:

“Troy saw it before everyone else did, and when I got here we had long talks about the roster… I realize he’s more than a one-position player.”

Monty Williams on Isaiah Stewart, Oct 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart:

“Disappointing, like a lot of our injuries. This is the time for those guys to get experience. But it's something that, fortunately he doesn't have to have surgery. That's the important thing.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Mar 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
“We want to be the best players we can be so the Pistons can be the best organization they can be. I’m a winner. Isaiah is a winner. We all want to win. That’s my mindset and I know that’s his mindset, too. It’s not a competition. We all just want to be great. He pushes me to be great. I try to do the same for him.”

Jalen Duren on Isaiah Stewart, Oct 22, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Isaiah Stewart, Saddiq Bey
item.description:
“He can make plays for others, can make plays for himself. This kid, he kind of reminds me of myself, the way that he attacks the basket. I don't know if I had any point-guard skills (laughs). I'm excited for Saddiq Bey and Stewart. Those guys bring a toughness that really represents Detroit and what we're about. I think it's time for them to take that next step.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Isaiah Stewart, Saddiq Bey, Jul 26, 2022. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart's return to the lineup:

“Isaiah was playing some of his best basketball, and just doing the little things, like timing on the screening and switching.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Mar 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
James Edwards III:Casey on Stewart’s shooting:

“I think the older he becomes, the game will slow down more and he’ll really shoot the 3.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Feb 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Casey on Isaiah Stewart, part 3:

“Great kid, young man. The kind of kid you want to take home to your family. Again, that was not a portrait of who he is as a man. Love him. He's a part of our family. And for us, that's in the rear view mirror.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Nov 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Casey on Isaiah Stewart, part 1:

“Isaiah is no where near what you saw in the video. I think if you put 9 men in that same situation, they probably would've reacted - right, wrong or indifferent - in the same manner. Maybe not as extended as Isaiah took it, which was unfortunate”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Nov 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Dwane Casey on LeBron James, Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Rod Beard:#PIstons Dwane Casey on Stewart-James suspensions:

“The league made a decision and we respect it ... it's unfortunate with all that happened. It's not what our organization stands for, but those things happen.”

Dwane Casey on LeBron James, Isaiah Stewart, Nov 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on being undersized with Isaiah Stewart:

“Davis is 7-feet and he's a talented man and athletic as hell and long...when we lost Stewart, that really hurt us.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Nov 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart incident:

“He shouldn't be facing anything. Not getting off the court in time (is a small thing)...I don't see any ramifications from the league on that.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Nov 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on LeBron James, Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on the altercation:

“It was a tough place with Isaiah -- his eye got cracked all the way all the way open ... I don't think (LeBron) James is a dirty player.”

Dwane Casey on LeBron James, Isaiah Stewart, Nov 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart:

“He was able to go today. I think it scared him more than anything else.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Nov 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Saddiq Bey on Isaiah Stewart, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
James Edwards III:Saddiq Bey on the battles between Isaiah Stewart and Kelly Olynyk:

“It's a great battle. Isaiah is a workhorse and Kelly is savvy. It's good to see them battle.”

Saddiq Bey on Isaiah Stewart, Kelly Olynyk, Oct 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart's defense:

“His ability to stay between the ball and basket is much better... his ability to communicate and coverage are much better.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Oct 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Tyrel Kirkham on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
“All the recognizable names it’s going to drive. However, we take pride in manufacturing moments and building our player’s brands, even if they may not be as well-known. Take Isaiah Stewart, for example. We leaned in and fans nicknamed him 'Beef Stew.' We create product, we create some really cool content in partnership with America’s Test Kitchen, and that ends up being one of our best-sellers in e-commerce throughout the year.”

Tyrel Kirkham on Isaiah Stewart, Jul 11, 2021. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Ben Wallace on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Piston Ben Wallace on similarities with Isaiah Stewart:

“I see a lot of myself in him... I don't want to see another Ben Wallace; I've closed that chapter. I would like to see guys take pieces of my game and add it to my game.”

Ben Wallace on Isaiah Stewart, Jun 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart:

“I didn’t know if the 3-point shooting, the offensive rebounding, if it would translate against bigger, stronger players. And it did.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, May 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart's energy:

“The old veterans don't like to use that much energy. It's not like Isaiah does it one time. He does it every time, whether it's during practice, games.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Apr 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey on Isaiah Stewart's ejection last night:

“He felt like he had let his team down a little bit. It's a learning experience... can't let other players bait you into getting thrown out of the game.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Mar 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
#PistonsJerami Grant on playing Isaiah Stewart for the first time:

“He only knows how to go one way -- and that's 100%.Even in shootaround, he goes at a high pace.”

Jerami Grant on Isaiah Stewart, Feb 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on rookie Isaiah Stewart:

“He is special...he's the only player I've ever been around who asked a question about our defensive pick-and-roll philosophy.”

Dwane Casey on Isaiah Stewart, Jan 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.
